newsitem.title: USA: U.S. cash soymeal - Rail basis falls with soy basis.
newsitem.headline: U.S. cash soymeal - Rail basis falls with soy basis.

text.p: Some soymeal basis offers were sharply lower Wednesday, falling in response to sluggish demand and a recent drop in soybean basis, merchandisers said.
"The basis appears to be a little weaker with the cheaper bean prices," said one dealer in Kentucky.
Soybean basis bids have fallen sharply in the past two days as farmers sell more old crop soybeans and processors cut back on purchases in anticipation of downtime in August.
Demand for soymeal is primarily limited to the spot market because end-users are still not willing to buy much supply at current prices, dealers said.
"I just think they (buyers) don't want to pay that carry," said a southeastern broker. "We're probably going to have to get back to 20 over ($20.00 per ton) FOB Illinois to get anybody interested."
Hot temperatures in the southeast and northeast have also dampened demand for feed from dairy farmers and poultry producers, dealers said.
"It's so hot down in the South, the animals just aren't eating much and there's plenty of hay out there for the dairy cattle," a dealer in the southeast U.S. said.
